L7.statement: Lemma 7 (windows): boundary cells are frozen ones, width <= n-3, F^t = identity on the frozen set and = phi^t on every window, t = 1..10; every state with non-empty frozen set that is not fully frozen

L8.statement: Lemma 8 (live window orbits): the periodic unfrozen orbits of the window map are {A_w, B_w} for w = 2 mod 3, the 3-cycle 0000, 1001, 1111 for w = 4, and none otherwise; all 2^w window states

L7c.statement: Lemma 7(c): a state with non-empty frozen set is periodic iff all its window contents are phi-periodic; every state with non-empty frozen set

L9.statement: Lemma 9: a periodic state with empty frozen set is 0 or has only runs of even length; their number is 1 for odd n and 2(2^(n/2 - 2^e) - 1) + 1 for even n = 2^(e+1) q, q odd (n >= 5); every periodic state

T1.statement: Theorem 1 (periodic states): a state is periodic iff it is 0, or a doubled word with periodic half word, or has non-empty frozen set and only live windows; every state

T1b.statement: Theorem 1, direction "periodic implies the description"; every periodic state

L10.statement: Lemma 10 (reversible freezing): in every state of the cycle whose first window is not 1001, the flip named in the lemma gives a periodic state of another cycle with a strictly larger frozen set; every cycle with non-empty frozen set that is not a block word

L11.statement: Lemma 11 (swap, both directions): x + e_(p+2) and x + e_(p+3) form a 2-cycle and x + e_(p+2) + e_(p+3) is the block word with the two blocks exchanged; every block word, every pair of consecutive blocks short, long

L12.statement: Lemma 12 (merge): F(x + e_(p+3)) is the block word with the three short blocks replaced by two long ones; every block word, every triple of consecutive short blocks

L13.statement: Lemma 13 (split): x + e_(p+2) has period 2; five steps after flipping the cell p+6 of its other state the block word with short, long, long replaced by four short blocks is reached; every block word, every occurrence of short, long, long

L16.statement: Lemma 16 (basin of 0): if 8 does not divide n, the states whose orbit ends in 0 are exactly 0, 1^n and the cyclic words over the blocks 001 and 0011 (case = one state of the basin of 0, or one such word)

LW.statement: Lemma W: every cell outside the window is frozen, F^t = identity outside and = phi^t inside, t = 1..6; every block word, every admissible window of width <= 7, every content (case = one content)

L16a.statement: Lemma 16 (i), (ii), (iii): F(x) = 0 iff x is 0 or 1^n; F(x) = 1^n iff x is a word over 001 and 0011; F(z) is such a word only if 8 divides n; every state (case = one state)
